description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

record.status: Discarded after 18 audited comparison trials; no read-timeout reduction, large process and whole-host CPU regressions.
record.previous_goal_turn: Progress: paired TCP observations and 24 audited pacing trials; fixed-rate pacing discarded
record.policy: Bounded 10 us NAPI polling per worker ring, dynamic tracking, no preferred polling or host IRQ changes. Effective configuration and physical NIC association verified; direct polling invocation is inferred from the kernel path, not measured by a privileged kernel trace.
record.profiling_limitation: sudo -n perf stat -e cycles:k -- true returned: sudo: a password is required. perf_event_paranoid is 2. No direct kernel stack profile obtained; use effective ring configuration and physical-NIC association with explicit inference limits.
record.acceptance: Evaluate timeout counts, throughput, p50/p99, process and whole-host CPU, memory, generator misses and every tie. Reject repeatable regressions without sufficient benefit; retain original deadlines and response validation.
record.next: Bounded sampled transmit timestamps to localize residual response loss.

record.caveat: Host CPU includes the server process and unrelated host work; never add process CPU to host CPU. Interior CPU windows omit the first 500 ms and last 200 ms and use available half-second samples. CPU per valid response is estimated with full-phase goodput. NIC missed-counter deltas can wrap and are not treated as loss totals. Worker CPU labels denote CPUs 9-15 even for Go, whose runtime can use all CPUs.

record.status: All ties, unfavorable metrics, and overlapping comparisons remain open.
record.scope: 18 GET runs: retained tcp-retries-v1, isolated napi-poll-v1, Go; three rotated trials per load.
record.queue_caveat: Host-wide counters cover whole runs, including setup, warmup, all offered phases, and cleanup. They are not per-request or phase attribution. ECN marks and drops are kept distinct.
record.trial_range_caveat: Three observed trial ranges are not formal confidence intervals.
